notes.title: CoopScoop v1.02b1.1 Released
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]:

📚 Cluck-tastic Tutorial!: Are you feeling a bit lost in the fields? Don't worry, we've plowed through the feedback and created a brand-new tutorial to help you navigate the farm with ease! Learn the ropes and become a top-tier farmer in no time.

🎙️ Farmer Feedback: Our resident farmer has been chirping away with some brand-new commentary. Whether you're idling in the fields or hurling objects at incredible speeds, expect some hilarious commentary from our farmer friend. Just don't let it ruffle your feathers! 

[b]Improvements[/b]:

🚚 Delivery changes: The planks for deliveries have been strategically relocated between the buttons, ensuring smoother operations and preventing any coop confusion. 

🚫 Button Ban: Any excessive button pressing in rapid succession will now incur a temporary ban.
